messages:
Maya (sec-eng): FYI SAST just raised a HIGH on a PR that touched rbac + kms code paths. looks like an audit-log call got removed during refactor :eyes: https://git.company/repo/pull/4821
scan-bot: SAST alert · severity=HIGH · rule=KMS_AUDIT_CALL_MISSING · fingerprint=aa3f7e · file=cloud/kms/creds.go:122-130 · link=https://sca.company/alerts/aa3f7e
Owen (backend): digging in. the refactor consolidated callers; one path accidentally dropped audit.LogKeyUsage(ctx, keyID) when error path returned early. snippet:
```go
-    if err != nil {
-        return nil, err
-    }
+    if err != nil {
+        // NOTE: removed audit call in refactor, re-add below
+        return nil, err
+    }
```
Samir (sre): is this exercised in staging? curious if we have any audit-events for the key in question since the deploy yesterday
Maya (sec-eng): looks like the change landed in the last deploy to staging (2026-03-12 03:14 UTC). no audit events for that key in staging logs since then.
Jen (qa): can we add a quick unit test asserting audit.LogKeyUsage invoked on both success and error paths? I can help add e2e with an fakes KMS in CI.
Paul (product): risk-wise: this widens the window where key-use won't be auditable. low chance of immediate data leak but high compliance impact — need a patch + release gating.
Owen (backend): will open a hotfix PR to re-add the call + add test. target: PR by EOD my timezone, include changelog note and link to SAST alert.
Maya (sec-eng): assign to Owen, please also include an automated e2e that hits the error path. once CI passes, request a canary rollout to dedicated infra only.
security-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1284 · title="Missing KMS audit call after refactor" · severity=LOW-MED (compliance) · assignee=Owen (backend) · link=https://inc.company/INC-2026-1284
Samir (sre): also update RBAC review: the refactor changed role checks to call IsAllowed(ctx, action) earlier; double-check we didn't accidentally broaden the principal allowed list. can you paste the role change diff?
Owen (backend): role diff is small, here's the selector change:
```diff
- allowed := roleStore.HasRole(userID, "kms:key-user")
+ allowed := roleStore.Evaluate(userID, []string{"kms:key-user"}, params)
```
Owen (backend): Evaluate had a fallback that allowed organization-admins implicitly; that fallback was added previously but not documented. I'll add an explicit check and unit test.
Jen (qa): after hotfix PR, we'll run the full SAST + DAST job in staging and export the SARIF for audit. ping me when ready.
Maya (sec-eng): triage decision: patch & tests first -> canary -> run SAST/DAST on canary -> full rollout if green. if failing SAST/DAST, rollback immediately. add suppression only with explicit review from Sec Eng lead + dev lead.
Paul (product): also loop in Compliance for the audit trail gap; want a short timeline for retro and notification if required.
Owen (backend): hotfix PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4829 · includes audit call re-add, unit tests, and updated role check.
scan-bot: SAST scan queued on PR 4829 · status=running
Maya (sec-eng): thanks — tagging this in the security runbook: add checklist item to validate audit events for any KMS change before cutting prod release.
security-oncall-bot: Runbook update logged: RUN-SEC-23 · author=Maya (sec-eng) · link=https://runbooks.company/RUN-SEC-23
Samir (sre): noted. I'll watch canary metrics and auditing. will escalate if missing events persist.
Jen (qa): running DAST now against canary. ETA ~30m.
Owen (backend): thanks all. will follow up in thread when CI + scans are green. :thumbsup:
Maya (sec-eng): leaving follow-ups: (1) add unit+e2e tests for audit calls (2) document Evaluate fallback behavior (3) Compliance notification if needed (4) add SAST suppression rationale only if we can't fix in reasonable time.
Paul (product): :lock: Good catch.
Owen (backend): CI green, SAST/DAST passed on canary. merging to main after changelog update.
Maya (sec-eng): closing loop — patch merged and deployed to prod with canary gating. post-deploy audit events show calls for key usage. leaving a postmortem note in INC-2026-1284. :white_check_mark:
